license_aladhan_desc: Prayer times, the Hijri calendar and calculation methods are obtained from this service. It requires no API key or membership.
license_city_db_desc: The names, coordinates and country-language relations of 245 countries and 141,135 cities are taken from this data set.
license_country_lang_desc: Information about which languages each country officially uses is taken from this data set.
license_diyanet_desc: The times shown in Turkey are taken from the tables published by the Presidency of Religious Affairs and are bundled with the app; no internet connection is required. Diyanet states that these times are based on its own official calculations.
license_diyanet_terms: Taken from the official website of the Presidency of Religious Affairs (Diyanet). This data is publicly accessible. Please contact Diyanet regarding redistribution terms.
license_geonames_desc: The canonical names and coordinates of large cities are taken from this data set. Since the main data set focuses on the district and village level, some major cities (e.g. Kahramanmaraş, Konya) were not included in it.
license_geonames_notice: This application uses the GeoNames cities15000 data set (© GeoNames, CC BY 4.0). GeoNames data has been merged with the application's own city database: the small settlement records of the source have been preserved, the canonical names and coordinates of major cities have been added, and duplicate records carrying the same coordinates have been merged. These changes were made with the tool/sehir_birlestir.dart and tool/mukerrer_birlestir.dart tools in this repository.
license_iso639_desc: The names of 152 languages in their own language and the ISO 639 code mapping are taken from this data set.
license_odbl_notice: This application contains data taken from data sets licensed under the Open Database Commons Open Database License (ODbL-1.0). Because ODbL-1.0 is a copyleft licence, applications that use and distribute this data must clearly state the source of the data. The licence terms of the source data sets are applied unchanged.
license_quran_desc: Verse texts and their translations are obtained from this service. Each translation has its own source.

reminder_common_desc: One interval for all prayers. Respects silent mode and Do Not Disturb.

setup_city_desc: Choose your city for the correct prayer times. Find My Location can find a nearby settlement, or you can select your country and city manually. Check the selected city before continuing.
setup_alert_desc: How would you like to be alerted for the five daily prayers? You can change each prayer, advance reminders and sounds later in Settings → Notification Settings.
setup_silent_desc: When enabled, the adhan also plays in silent mode. Playing during Do Not Disturb is disabled and can be enabled separately in Settings.
setup_permissions_desc: Permissions will be requested in order. You can still view your chosen city’s prayer times if you decline. Tap a missing permission to open system settings.
setup_notification_desc: To display prayer alerts and the adhan playback notification.
setup_alarm_desc: To start the adhan and prayer alerts on time.
setup_location_desc: For Find My Location and qibla. Not needed for manual city selection; your location is not tracked in the background.
setup_missing_desc: Notification or exact alarm access is missing. Alerts may not arrive or may be delayed. You can grant access later in Settings → Notification Settings.
setup_permission_error: Could not read permission status. You can check system settings and continue to view prayer times.
setup_location_off: Location is off. Turn it on to use Find My Location, or choose your city manually.
setup_location_denied: Location permission was not granted. Choose your city manually or try Find My Location again.
setup_location_error: Could not find your location. Choose your city manually or try again.
